---
name: Content correction
about: Report an error, inconsistency, or unclear passage in the framework material
title: "[CORRECTION] "
labels: correction
---

## Where

The file and, if relevant, the specific section or line.

## What is wrong

The error, inconsistency, or unclear passage.

## What you think it should be

Proposed correction or clarification. If you are open to submitting
a pull request with the fix, mention that here.

## Why

If the correction is based on your own experience with the
framework, a brief note on the situation that exposed the problem.
Corrections grounded in real use tend to produce better revisions
than ones based only on theory.
